concerns.text: T002 is tagged [P] to run in parallel with T001, but its own verification clause requires 'a 50-step smoke train run on the T001 batch reduces loss monotonically' — i.e., T002's acceptance consumes T001's output (data/physics/ train batch + the loader in T002 reads that data). The implementation work is parallel-safe, but the task as written (implementation + verification) is not. Either split the smoke-train verification into a follow-on step after T001, or note in the execution-order line that T002's verification gate waits for T001's batch.
